pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacco Barrel$() handles pressing, fermentation, aging, and several specialty tobacco processes. It accepts $(item)loose tobacco$() or $(item)cured tobacco leaf$(). Fresh raw leaf and Spoiled Tobacco are rejected.

A barrel holds up to $(item)64$() items. Additional tobacco must be exactly compatible with the existing stored stack, including its components/processing data. Adding more tobacco to a batch resets the current active barrel-process progress.
pages.title: Batch Rules

pages.text: Right-click with valid tobacco to insert as much as the barrel can accept. Right-click with an empty hand to remove the entire stored batch. Sneak-right-click prints detailed status. Spectacles provide a more compact live overlay.
pages.title: Interaction

pages.text: The barrel chooses its mode from both the tobacco and its surroundings. Rough Cut under pressure enters $(thing)Pressing$(). Valid specialty stoving takes priority next, then fermentation, then aging. If no process requirements are met, the barrel remains $(thing)Idle$().
pages.title: Automatic Modes
Create Extraction
pages.text: Create automation treats finite barrel work and aging differently. Pressing, stoving, and active fermentation are protected finite batches, so automated extraction waits until they finish. Aging has no universal endpoint, so it remains extractable; use an aging Attribute Filter when you want an automated cellar to wait for a specific age.
